## About
Jack's Auto Sales & Salvage is a used auto parts yard on N Main St in St Charles. We carry used and aftermarket parts for all years of all makes and models, foreign and domestic.
Buying a used part keeps a good piece of a car in use instead of in the scrap pile. As we like to say, auto recyclers help save the environment.
On our parts site you can search by image, run a multi-part search, or search in Spanish. We're open weekdays and hold a 4.1 rating from 118 Google reviews.

## Services
- Used and aftermarket parts: We carry both used parts and aftermarket parts.
- All years, makes and models: Foreign and domestic, from all years of all makes and models.
- Extended warranties: Every part has a 30-day standard warranty, with extended warranties available.

## FAQ
Q: Do your parts come with a warranty?
A: Yes. Parts come with a 30-day standard warranty, and extended warranties are available.

Q: Should I bring my old part?
A: One customer recommends bringing the part you're replacing, or you may be charged a core charge.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're open Monday through Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday.
